results.title: Demographics | Annapolis, MD
results.content: Annapolis is a moderately sized city with a population of about 40,800 as of the 2020 Census, showing modest growth over the past decade. It is characterized by a diverse racial and ethnic population, a relatively high median household income, and a well-educated community.

results.title: Annapolis, Maryland - Wikipedia
results.content: Situated on the Chesapeake Bay at the mouth of the Severn River, 25 miles (40 km) south of Baltimore and about 30 miles (50 km) east of Washington, D.C., Annapolis forms part of the Baltimore-Washington metropolitan area. The 2020 census recorded its population as 40,812, an increase of 6.3% since 2010.
